facts.statement: The holotype specimen, IVPP V15979, was discovered in the late Campanian layers of the Bayan Mandahu Formation.
facts.quote: The holotype, IVPP V15979, was found in layers of the Bayan Mandahu dating from the late Campanian.

facts.statement: Some fragmentary foot elements are known from the Machairasaurus fossil record.
facts.quote: Some fragmentary foot elements are also known.

facts.statement: Five oviraptorid specimens associated with a nest, including a female found brooding near eggs, may belong to Machairasaurus.
facts.quote: Five oviraptorid specimens associated with a nest, the female having been found brooding near the eggs, may belong to Machairasaurus.

facts.statement: In 2010, Machairasaurus was assigned to the family Oviraptoridae, specifically to the subfamily Ingeniinae.
facts.quote: In 2010, Machairasaurus was assigned to the Oviraptoridae, more precisely to the Ingeniinae.

facts.statement: Machairasaurus formed a smaller clade with Heyuannia, Conchoraptor, and Nemegtomaia.
facts.quote: It formed a smaller clade with Heyuannia spp., Conchoraptor, and Nemegtomaia.

facts.statement: Machairasaurus was found in the Upper Cretaceous Bayan Mandahu Formation in China.
facts.quote: Machairasaurus is a genus of oviraptorid dinosaur which was found in the Upper Cretaceous Bayan Mandahu Formation, China.

facts.statement: Machairasaurus lived during the late Cretaceous, approximately 80 million years ago, in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: que vivió a finales del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente 80 millones de años, durante el Campaniense, en lo que hoy es Asia.

facts.statement: Machairasaurus was assigned to the family Oviraptoridae and the subfamily Ingeniinae in 2010.
facts.quote: Machairasaurus fue asignado en 2010 a la familia Oviraptoridae, más exactamente a la subfamilia Ingeniinae.

facts.statement: Machairasaurus forms a small clade with Ingenia yanshini, Heyuannia huangi, Conchoraptor gracilis, and Nemegtomaia barsboldi.
facts.quote: Forma un pequeño clado con "Ingenia" yanshini, Heyuannia huangi, Conchoraptor gracilis y Nemegtomaia barsboldi.

facts.statement: The time range for Machairasaurus is the Campanian stage, from 83.6 to 72.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Campanian to Campanian (83.6 to 72.2 million years ago)
